hero.title: Welcome to Al-Diyafa Hotel
hero.subtitle: Where refined luxury meets genuine Arabian hospitality in the heart of Riyadh

intro.title: An Exceptional Stay Beyond Expectations
intro.text: Nestled in Riyadh's finest district, Al-Diyafa Hotel presents a modern concept of luxury and serenity. We offer our distinguished guests spacious suites, world-class dining, and holistic wellness amenities for a memorable stay whether traveling for business or leisure.

rooms.title: Luxury Rooms & Suites
rooms.subtitle: Impeccably designed spaces providing the ultimate comfort and tranquility

standard.name: Deluxe Standard Room
standard.desc: A cozy, elegant retreat equipped with contemporary amenities, ideal for solo travelers or couples.

deluxe.name: Superior City View Room
deluxe.desc: Stunning panoramic skyline views accompanied by a comfortable lounge and premium amenities.

suite.name: Executive Suite
suite.desc: An expansive suite featuring a separate living room and exclusive VIP Executive Lounge access.

royal.name: Royal Suite
royal.desc: The pinnacle of grandeur and privacy with a scenic balcony, private dining, and 24/7 butler service.

family.name: Spacious Family Suite
family.desc: Interconnecting rooms with a shared family lounge, entertainment hub, and child-friendly comforts.

executive.name: Business Executive Room
executive.desc: A tailored productive environment with an ergonomic work desk, high-speed Wi-Fi, and refined quietness.

services.title: Refined Services & Amenities
services.subtitle: Everything you desire for an inspiring stay all in one magnificent venue

restaurant.name: Gourmet International Restaurant
restaurant.desc: Culinary excellence featuring lavish daily buffets and authentic dishes crafted by renowned master chefs.

spa.name: Spa & Holistic Wellness
spa.desc: Rejuvenating massages and natural spa therapies designed to revitalize both body and spirit.

pool.name: Heated Outdoor Pool
pool.desc: Unwind under the sun in a temperature-controlled pool accompanied by refreshing poolside beverages.

gym.name: State-of-the-Art Fitness Center
gym.desc: Advanced cardio and strength equipment with certified trainers available upon request.

meeting.name: Meeting & Event Venues
meeting.desc: Sophisticated conference spaces fitted with cutting-edge audiovisual technology for events of all scales.

room_service.name: 24/7 Room Service
room_service.desc: An expansive in-room dining menu served promptly to your door at any hour of day or night.

wifi.name: Complimentary Ultra-Fast Wi-Fi
wifi.desc: Seamless, high-bandwidth wireless internet access throughout all guest rooms and public areas.

parking.name: Secure Parking & Valet
parking.desc: Complimentary covered parking for guests complete with dedicated, professional valet service.

concierge.name: Dedicated Concierge Team
concierge.desc: Personalized assistance for flight bookings, city excursions, and luxury chauffeur services.

about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: A legacy of craftsmanship and distinction in luxury hospitality
about.story_text: Our journey began with a clear aspiration: to blend legendary Arabian generosity with world-class hospitality standards. Today, Al-Diyafa stands as the premier destination for business pioneers and travelers seeking an harmonious blend of grandeur and heartfelt care.
about.vision_text: To be the foremost benchmark for authentic, ultra-luxurious hospitality in the Kingdom.
about.mission_text: To craft tailored experiences and heartfelt memories that exceed our guests' highest expectations.
about.values_text: Authenticity, uncompromising quality, professionalism, and guest-first mindset.
about.team_subtitle: Passionate professionals devoted to your supreme comfort
